messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick debrief from Brightlane onboarding call — capturing asks so we can feed product.
TL;DR: top pains: (1) per-route billing visibility, (2) embedding search relevance drop after retrains, (3) console UX: token breakdown by route. They also requested a per-account routing-policy override during pilot. Attaching notes: https://redwood.app/notes/brightlane-onboard

OnboardBot: Meeting notes uploaded: https://redwood.app/notes/brightlane-onboard — transcript attached.

Liu (AE): Account health = medium risk. They're trialing ~500k tokens/mo; billing opacity is primary renewal risk. If not addressed in 2 weeks, likely reduce spend.

Marco (Product PM): Thanks. Can you add severity + one or two example prompts showing the embeddings relevance issue? Also which model/quant are they using? I'll tag Optimize. @Sam (CS Ops) can you add to product-signal queue?

Priya (CSM): Example prompt they used: "Find our routing policy for refunds" — results returned unrelated docs. They're on dedicated with embeddings-v2-quant. Severity: Billing = high, Embeddings = medium. They asked explicitly for manual routing override during pilot.

Sam (CS Ops): Added P0 tag to product-signal and created ticket PS-4789: https://tickets.redwood/PS-4789. Included transcript and sample queries. Please +1 if this matches.

Marco (Product PM): Assigned to me for triage. I'll sync with Optimize on evals and Console on a quick UX patch. ETA: triage by EOD Friday. :handshake:

Priya (CSM): Great — I'll tell the customer we're tracking and will share ETA. Can we aim for a small console patch (token breakdown per-route) as quick win this week?

Marco (Product PM): Pushing for it. If we can't ship a patch fast, we'll propose a temporary CSV export/dashboard from CS Ops as a stopgap.
